message: args.resolved is missing: the speech of the items is not known.
hint: The service fills it from the speech map made when a file is imported (no transcript is needed): call media_inspect on the speech assets, and if one is still analysing wait for its job (job_get) and retry; send audio.duck in a later call than the one that adds the speech items; an asset without audio has no speech. The cause is the state of the assets, not the arguments.
